from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol()
ru=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Ru'));si=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Si'));rw.AddBond(ru,si,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rings=[];phos=[];mets=[]
for k in range(3):
 ring=[rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C')) for i in range(6)]
 for j in range(6):rw.AddBond(ring[j],ring[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
 rw.AddBond(si,ring[0],Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
 p=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('P'));rw.AddBond(p,ring[1],Chem.BondType.SINGLE);rw.AddBond(p,ru,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
 ms=[]
 for j in range(2):
  c=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'));rw.AddBond(p,c,Chem.BondType.SINGLE);ms.append(c)
 rings.append(ring);phos.append(p);mets.append(ms)
pax=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('P'));rw.AddBond(pax,ru,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
axms=[]
for j in range(3):
 c=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'));rw.AddBond(pax,c,Chem.BondType.SINGLE);axms.append(c)
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m);m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m),'N',m.GetNumAtoms())
print('types',[(i,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetHybridization(),AllChem.GetUFFAtomParams(m,i) if hasattr(AllChem,'GetUFFAtomParams') else '') for i in [si]+phos+[pax]])
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(np.random.normal(),np.random.normal(),np.random.normal()))
m.AddConformer(conf)
try:
 ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
 print('FF',ff,'energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
except Exception as e: print('FF failed',e)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'graph.mol')

cat >> build.py <<'PY'
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
# one aromatic chelate ring in an x,z plane; replicate by 120-degree rotations
Si=np.array([0.,-2.34]);P=np.array([2.30,0.])
def ring2d(q):
 center=q[:2];theta=q[2];angs=theta-np.arange(6)*np.pi/3
 return center+1.40*np.array([np.cos(angs),np.sin(angs)]).T
def err(q):
 r=ring2d(q);svec=Si-r[0];pvec=P-r[1]
 return [(np.linalg.norm(svec)-1.88)*3,(np.linalg.norm(pvec)-1.84)*3,
  (np.dot(svec,r[0]-q[:2])/np.linalg.norm(svec)/1.4-1)*2,
  (np.dot(pvec,r[1]-q[:2])/np.linalg.norm(pvec)/1.4-1)*2]
q=least_squares(err,[3.15,-3.15,2.8]).x
print('ring position',q,'err',err(q))
pos=np.zeros((m.GetNumAtoms(),3))
pos[ru]=[0,0,0];pos[si]=[0,0,-2.34];pos[pax]=[0,0,2.32]
for k,(ring,p,ms) in enumerate(zip(rings,phos,mets)):
 theta=k*2*np.pi/3
 radial=np.array([np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta),0.]);normal=np.array([-np.sin(theta),np.cos(theta),0.])
 zdir=np.array([0.,0.,1.])
 for c,v in zip(ring,ring2d(q)): pos[c]=v[0]*radial+v[1]*zdir
 pos[p]=2.30*radial
 dc=(pos[ring[1]]-pos[p]);dc/=np.linalg.norm(dc)
 dr=-radial
 t=-(dc+dr);t/=np.linalg.norm(t)
 for c,sg in zip(ms,[-1,1]):pos[c]=pos[p]+1.84*(t/np.sqrt(3)+sg*normal*np.sqrt(2/3))
for k,c in enumerate(axms):
 theta=(k*2*np.pi/3)+np.pi/6
 pos[c]=pos[pax]+1.84*np.array([np.sqrt(8/9)*np.cos(theta),np.sqrt(8/9)*np.sin(theta),1/3])
# Add hydrogens around aromatic and methyl carbons.
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 i=a.GetIdx()
 if a.GetAtomicNum()!=6:continue
 hs=[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1]
 if not hs:continue
 ns=[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()!=1]
 if a.GetIsAromatic():
  v=sum((pos[i]-pos[n])/np.linalg.norm(pos[i]-pos[n]) for n in ns);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
  pos[hs[0]]=pos[i]+1.08*v
 else:
  axis=pos[i]-pos[ns[0]];axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
  temp=np.array([0.,0.,1.]) if abs(axis[2])<0.9 else np.array([1.,0.,0.])
  u=np.cross(axis,temp);u/=np.linalg.norm(u);v=np.cross(axis,u)
  for k,h in enumerate(hs):
   angle=2*np.pi*k/3
   pos[h]=pos[i]+1.09*(axis/3+np.sqrt(8/9)*(u*np.cos(angle)+v*np.sin(angle)))
for i,v in enumerate(pos):m.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,v)
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
for i in [ru,si,pax]:ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
for p in phos:
 ff.UFFAddDistanceConstraint(ru,p,False,2.25,2.35,400.)
 ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(si,ru,p,False,83.,94.,100.)
 ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(pax,ru,p,False,86.,97.,100.)
for i in range(3):
 for j in range(i):ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(phos[i],ru,phos[j],False,114.,122.,70.)
for ring in rings:ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(ru,si,ring[0],False,105.,114.,100.)
# Restrict each P lone pair toward Ru: phosphines are pseudo-tetrahedral.
for p,ring,ms in zip(phos,rings,mets):
 for c in [ring[1]]+ms:ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(ru,p,c,False,102.,118.,70.)
for c in axms:ff.UFFAddAngleConstraint(ru,pax,c,False,104.,115.,100.)
ff.Initialize()
print('init energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
for i in range(8):
 ret=ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000,energyTol=1e-8,forceTol=1e-5)
 print('opt',i,ret,ff.CalcEnergy())
 if ret==0:break
pos=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
np.save('positions.npy',pos)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'optimized.mol')
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(pos)}\nTris(2-dimethylphosphinophenyl)silyl ruthenium(trimethylphosphine); S=1/2\n')
 for a,v in zip(m.GetAtoms(),pos):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {v[0]: .8f} {v[1]: .8f} {v[2]: .8f}\n')
print('Bonds:')
for p in phos:print('RuP',p,np.linalg.norm(pos[p]-pos[ru]))
# Render to inspect.
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(10,10));ax=fig.add_subplot(111,projection='3d')
colors={'C':'#555555','H':'#cccccc','P':'orange','Si':'gold','Ru':'#507bcc'}
for a,v in zip(m.GetAtoms(),pos):
 ax.scatter(*v,c=colors[a.GetSymbol()],s=20 if a.GetSymbol()=='H' else 90)
 if a.GetSymbol() in ['Ru','P','Si']:ax.text(*v,a.GetSymbol()+str(a.GetIdx()))
for b in m.GetBonds():
 vs=pos[[b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()]]
 ax.plot(vs[:,0],vs[:,1],vs[:,2],c='black',lw=1)
ax.set_box_aspect([1,1,1]);ax.view_init(elev=10,azim=35)
plt.savefig('render.png',dpi=140)
